defects: Quantity shortfall: 60 EACH invoiced, only 52 EACH received (8 kits damaged and refused at the dock) — clause 4 under-delivery
rationale: Receipt GR-7724 shows 52 of 60 kits accepted (8 refused as damaged), so under clause 4 the quantity resolves in favour of the receipt and payment is limited to 52 × $320.00 = $16,640.00 net. Tax recomputed at the vendor's 7.5% rate on the corrected net is $1,248.00 (clause 5), giving a corrected gross of $17,888.00; the supplier's $1,440.00 tax is simply the consequence of the over-invoiced quantity, not a separate defect. Unit price matches the PO exactly, so only one defect exists and clause 11 escalation is not triggered; $17,888.00 requires AP_MANAGER approval under clause 10.
